exposure: Type of AoD (Type A vs. Type B)
Timing of delivery relative to surgery (delivery first vs. surgery first)
cohort: The study included 30 pregnant women with Marfan syndrome (mean age 30.7 years) who sustained aortic dissection during pregnancy or postpartum between 1998 and 2019.
finding: The management strategy for aortic dissection in pregnant women with Marfan syndrome, tailored to the type of dissection and gestational age, significantly determines maternal and fetal survival.
mod_finding: Different approaches to the timing of C-section relative to surgical repair (C-section first, single-stage C-section and surgery, or surgery first followed by C-section) were key components of management strategies, showing varying maternal and fetal mortality rates.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at aortic dissection was 28.3 +/- 8.8 weeks; deliveries occurred at various gestational ages, including 35.4 +/- 6.1 weeks and 32.0 +/- 5.0 weeks for C-sections, and 18.0 +/- 5.8 weeks for surgery-first cases.
